instructions: Present the assumptions and decision making criteria to the user and ask for their opinion on key decisions.
1. Load typical assumptions from `typical_assumptions.json` and review them with the user
2. Load each decision criteria from `decision_criteria/` folder and present its options
3. Ask user to review assumptions and select preferred criteria/options
4. Confirm test scope level (Component/Service, System, or Whole solution)
5. Confirm mocking strategy (Real implementations, Mock framework/tools, Mock external dependencies, or No mocking)
6. Validate selections before generating test code
